items.source: The backing JCache javax.cache.CacheManager can be set via the setCacheManager(CacheManager) bean property.
items.translation: 底层的 JCache `javax.cache.CacheManager` 可以通过 `setCacheManager(CacheManager)` 属性进行设置。

items.source: Called by AbstractCacheManager.afterPropertiesSet() on startup. The returned collection may be empty but must not be null.
items.translation: 由启动时调用的AbstractCacheManager.afterPropertiesSet()方法调用。返回的集合可能为空，但绝不能为null。

items.source: Default is "true", despite JSR-107 itself not supporting null values. An internal holder object will be used to store user-level nulls.
items.translation: 默认值为"true"，尽管 JSR-107 本身不支持 `null` 值。将使用一个内部持有对象来存储用户级别的 `null` 值。

items.source: Caches may be lazily created at runtime if the native provider supports it. If a lookup by name does not yield any result, an AbstractCacheManager subclass gets a chance to register such a cache at runtime. The returned cache will be automatically added to this cache manager.
items.translation: 如果原生提供者支持，缓存可能会在运行时懒式创建。如果按名称查找未返回任何结果，AbstractCacheManager 的子类将有机会在运行时注册此类缓存。返回的缓存将被自动添加到该缓存管理器中。
